why: Image 2 reads more like a real photographer's frame: an oblique corner view with real depth, focus falloff, a textured plaster wall and a single speaker sitting believably on its oak plinth, although the evenly spaced curtain folds still look computer-generated. Image 1 is a flat, symmetrical stage set: both speakers are cut off at the edges, the red cabinets glow as if lit from inside, the chair backs block the bottom of the frame and the wood grain looks printed on, so it reads as a render rather than a room.
